notes: Fixed: recordings made without the Click Helper ended up with no steps. The Record window now shows the one-time Click Helper setup and notices the moment it's installed, with no reload.
Click Helper 1.1: starts working in tabs that are already open as soon as you install it.
Fixed: on some screens (like Retina Macs) clicks could be ignored because the tab's shape was misread.
Video is now recorded with the most reliable encoder first, and switches to a backup recorder if one fails, so the video between steps is never lost.
If a recording ends with no steps, Demoflow explains why and keeps your video.
